hero_title: ENGINEERING THAT TRANSFORMS OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS INTO AIR NAVIGATION SOLUTIONS.
hero_sub: GIDEA-IFPD specialises in instrument flight procedure design, airspace engineering and aerodrome environment analysis.
sec1_lead: Specialised design of instrument flight procedures considering operational requirements, aerodrome characteristics, airspace environment and applicable ICAO design criteria.
card1_text: Trajectory design, aircraft performance analysis, obstacle assessment surfaces (OAS) and obstacle evaluation.
card2_text: Design based on conventional navigation aids (VOR, NDB, ILS/DME), ensuring obstacle clearance, minima and ARINC 424 coding.
card3_text: RNAV and RNP procedure design per ICAO Doc 9613. RNAV(GNSS), RNP APCH and advanced PBN solutions.
card4_text: Design for complex aerodrome environments, maximising airspace utilisation with curved and RF leg segments.
sec2_lead: Aeronautical studies and engineering solutions to assess the feasibility, operation and aeronautical impact of new installations and planned developments.
box1_text: Assessment of site alternatives for new aerodromes, heliports, infrastructure and projects requiring specific aeronautical conditions.
box2_text: Operational safety risk assessments (ICAO Doc 9859) associated with changes in procedures, airspace structure, infrastructure or flight operations.
box3_text: Assessment of the aeronautical impact of constructions, urban developments, wind farms and new installations on existing aerodrome operations (ICAO Annex 14).
box4_text: Integrated evaluations of the interaction between aerodrome, aircraft performance, infrastructure, airspace structure and instrument flight procedures.
cap1_text: Aeronautical feasibility assessment and procedure design from initial planning stages.
cap2_text: Analysis and redesign of ATS routes, TMA structures and terminal area procedures.
cap3_text: Review and improvement of existing instrument flight procedure structures.
cap4_text: Evaluation of the aeronautical impact of infrastructure modifications on flight operations.
cap5_text: Proprietary tools for procedure calculations and technical validation.
sec4_lead: Technical Rigour · Data Integrity · Operational Safety
std1_text: Criteria for the construction of visual and instrument flight procedures, Vol. II — Construction of Visual and Instrument Flight Procedures.
std2_text: Quality Assurance Manual for Flight Procedure Design — the framework for quality in every procedure deliverable.
std3_text: Every technical process is supported by a complete Technical Dossier (Expediente Técnico) ensuring full design traceability.
